name: Clouding

evidence.vps: 03: hosted virtual server; the customer manages the guest OS, app and maintenance

line: Configure a self-managed virtual server with hourly billing.

free.text: One-time €5 signup balance; no recurring free server plan

work.math: €3 a month. It is €5 if the 25 GB disk minimum applies. 100 GB fits within the 4 TB of transfer. Builds are separate. Before VAT.
730 hours at €0.011 an hour = €8.03, capped at €8 a month. 100 GB fits within the 4 TB of transfer, before VAT.
€11.50 for the VM, plus €5.60 for 7 daily copies of 40 GB at €0.02 per GB. Total €17.10 before VAT.
